title: The map on differentials for a surjection, with its kernel identified
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a surjection of algebras over a base square, the induced map on differentials is surjective with kernel generated by the differentials of elements whose image lies in the base (statement lines 34194-34202). The proof does not work with derivations: it reads surjectivity off the induced map of presentations and computes the kernel by writing an element mapping to zero in a normal form, then using the relation in the target to express its coefficients (proof lines 34204-34234). Choosing that normal form for the kernel computation is the step that carries the argument. H2.
